text:
A sample of fertiliser is tested by warming it with aqueous sodium hydroxide.
A colourless gas is produced which turns damp red litmus paper blue.
Which element, essential for plant growth, must be present?
A
nitrogen
B
phosphorus
C
potassium
D
sulfur
subject: Chemistry
